clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Wetlands, Green Belt lies below the ridges of Grim Batol. Bog beasts, crocolisks, and toxic oozes roam its marshes, while Rethiel the Greenwarden keeps watch alone.

Green Belt fills the eastern interior of Wetlands, where mossy waters make travel hazardous. Massive crocolisks, shifting oozes, and shambling bog beasts roam the fen. Deep within it, a solitary watch post is manned by Rethiel the Greenwarden, a night elf who studies the fen's ecology and keeps its hostile creatures in check.

Wreckage from a Dragonmaw clan caravan lies scattered in the muck, left behind after the catastrophic battle at nearby Grim Batol. Crimson whelplings linger around the broken carts and crushed cages, reminders of the clan's past enslavement of Alexstrasza and her red dragon brood.
